name: Nishioka Takeshi
source:
He has a baby face and is short, so he’s often mistaken for a student. Women in general tend to like him a lot, often saying he’s “like a cute little brother.”

He’s what you’d call a geeky young man who loves computers. His style is the epitome of the Akihabara look: short hair, jeans, and anime T-shirts. He carries a paper bag and a backpack.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/366945/]Getchu[/url]]
